query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        ARRAY_AGG(
            CASE
                WHEN vessel_one = $1 THEN vessel_two
                WHEN vessel_two = $1 THEN vessel_one
            END
        ),
        '{}'
    ) AS "ids!: Vec<FiskeridirVesselId>"
FROM
    vessel_catch_similarity_distances v
WHERE
    (
        vessel_one = $1
        OR vessel_two = $1
    )
    AND distance < 0.4
